changes.description: Names its replacement. The 0.2.0 retirement carried replacementCandidate forward as null from 0.1.0, and null is not a neutral value here: by this project's own rule it reads as NOT REPLACEABLE, which is the state that makes a saved workflow refuse to open rather than migrate. This widget is fully replaceable -- apply_ruleset declares a migrationFrom adapter for it at src/core.ts#validateWorkflow, pinning the ruleset at the version that produced this widget's results -- so the field said the opposite of what the adapter does. Found by building the retired-widget lookup in docs/usage.md, which is what reading a declared field rather than the prose beside it is for.
